# Settings with one station counter on Press A (Station 1, id 51), every position countable.
## Settings › + Add station counter: Station 2 on S2.Count
  1  POST /api/processes/1/station-counters
       {
         "label": "Station 2",
         "tag_name": "S2.Count",
         "tag_name_2": ""
       }
  2  GET /api/processes/1/station-counters
  3  GET /api/process-nodes
  4  GET /api/processes/1/counting-slots
  5  GET /api/processes/1/catid-health
  6  GET /api/process-nodes/201/countable
  7  GET /api/process-nodes/202/countable
  8  GET /api/process-nodes/203/countable
  9  GET /api/process-nodes/204/countable
 10  GET /api/process-nodes/205/countable
 11  GET /api/process-nodes/206/countable
 12  GET /api/process-nodes/207/countable
 13  GET /api/process-nodes/208/countable
 14  GET /api/process-nodes/209/countable
 15  GET /api/process-nodes/210/countable
 16  GET /api/process-nodes/211/countable
 17  GET /api/process-nodes/212/countable
 18  GET /api/process-nodes/213/countable
 19  GET /api/process-nodes/214/countable
 20  GET /api/process-nodes/215/countable
 21  GET /api/process-nodes/216/countable
-- sheet closed

## Settings › Station 1 › Edit: Station 1b
  1  PUT /api/station-counters/51
       {
         "label": "Station 1b",
         "tag_name": "S1.Count",
         "tag_name_2": ""
       }

  3  GET /api/process-nodes
  4  GET /api/processes/1/counting-slots

## Settings › POS_A1 › Counted at: Station 1 (the select's change)
  1  PUT /api/process-nodes/201/counted-at
       {
         "line_counter_id": 51
       }
  2  GET /api/processes/1/station-counters
  3  GET /api/process-nodes
  4  GET /api/processes/1/counting-slots
  5  GET /api/processes/1/catid-health
  6  GET /api/process-nodes/201/countable
  7  GET /api/process-nodes/202/countable

## Settings › POS_A2 › Counted at: New station counter… (Station 3 on S3.Count, then the bind)
